blocks.text: Filipino-American actor Vincent Rodriguez III is set to make an appearance in the long-running medical drama “Grey’s Anatomy,” joining its 23rd season as a guest star. Rodriguez announced the news in a Facebook post on Tuesday, Nov. 3, sharing a photo of himself wearing a hospital gown and showing off a hospital wristband bearing the name of the fictional Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital. “Finally visited Grey+Sloan Memorial. This Thursday, November 5, you’ll be seeing this Filipino as a patient on Grey’s Anatomy,” he wrote. The actor said he could not yet reveal the identity of his character but expressed gratitude to […]...
